description: This file defines the SugarOAuth class, which extends Zend_Oauth_Consumer to implement OAuth client functionality within the SuiteCRM project. It provides methods for creating tokens, setting tokens, retrieving request and access tokens from URLs, making authenticated requests, and handling OAuth communication specifics.

classes.name: SugarOAuth
classes.description: A class extending Zend_Oauth_Consumer to handle OAuth authentication flow, token management, and HTTP requests with OAuth signing within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth client with consumer key, secret, and optional parameters.

methods.name: enableDebug
methods.description: Enables debugging for the OAuth process (stub implementation returning self).

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets the OAuth token and secret.

methods.name: makeRequestToken
methods.description: Creates a Zend_Oauth_Token_Request object configured with the current token.

methods.name: makeAccessToken
methods.description: Creates a Zend_Oauth_Token_Access object configured with the current token.

methods.name: getRequestTokenByUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a request token from the given URL, optionally using a callback, and merges query parameters.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token from the specified URL, optionally using a request token.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to a given URL with OAuth signing, handling proxies and headers.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns an HTTP client configured with the OAuth access token.

methods.name: getLastResponse
methods.description: Returns the last raw response body from an OAuth request.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last HTTP request made.
